headline: XBIO (FOOD) jumps 12.5% on an 8.3σ volume spike, coinciding with a medium‑sized acquisition‑disposal filing.
market_take: Property stocks dominate the session with several >10% gains, led by EVER up 28.57% and RABBIT up 11.43%. In Food, XBIO’s surge is the standout, while COCOCO also posted a 4.5σ volume spike. Consumer and construction sectors see strong activity: CNT (CONS) recorded a 21.0σ volume spike and a 10.91% intraday rise, and CCP (CONMAT) posted an 11.54% move on a 6.4σ volume surge.

sector_notes.note: XBIO surged 12.5% with an 8.3σ volume spike and filed a medium‑sized acquisition‑disposal notice; COCOCO also logged a 4.5σ volume spike.
Multiple prop tickers posted double‑digit gains: EVER +28.57%, RABBIT +11.43%, RML +11.11%, UV +7.14% and JCK +8.33% intraday.
M‑STOR rose 12.90% and opened with a 7.74% price gap, adding to the sector’s positive bias.
CNT recorded a 21.0σ volume spike and a 10.91% intraday rise; SRICHA fell 6.52% intraday.
CCP posted an 11.54% intraday gain on a 6.4σ volume spike; PPP showed a 6.76% open‑gap price move.

watchlist.reason: 12.5% intraday rise with 8.3σ volume spike; recent acquisition‑disposal filing.
Largest 1‑day gain at +28.57% with solid volume.
